messages:
maria-ops: Quick question — digging into latency for model=redwood-13b in prod. Need a single place to pull p50/p95/p99 TTFT + tokens/sec for the last 24h and traces to correlate tails. Any canonical dashboard/link and which panels/queries to use?

noah-eng-platform: Use Grafana: https://grafana.redwoodinternal.com/d/latency/latency-overview?orgId=1&var-model=redwood-13b
Panels to look at: "TTFT (p50/p95/p99)", "Tokens/sec (tokens_inflight)", and "Request rate by seq_len". Quick PromQL snippets:
```
# p95 TTFT (ms)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(ttft_bucket[5m])) by (le, model)) * 1000

# tokens/sec
sum(rate(tokens_processed_total[1m])) by (model)
```
Also set the Grafana time range to 24h and group by `region` if you need rollout correlation. :mag:

suzanne-sre: For traces use Tempo/Jaeger: https://tempo.redwoodinternal.com/search?service=inference
Look for span `model_inference.forward` and filter by tag `model=redwood-13b` and `seq_len`. Common slow-path causes: KV cache miss spikes (`kv_cache_hit_ratio`), sudden surge in long sequences, or backend fanning (multiple model calls). If p99 spikes, check backend queue length (`inflight_requests`) and GPU saturation metrics.

pri-devex: If you plan to create alerts, start with conservative thresholds and iterate. Example alert rules (PrometheusAlert format):
```
- alert: Inference_TTFT_P95_High
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(ttft_bucket[5m])) by (le, model)) * 1000 > 1500
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "P95 TTFT > 1.5s for {{ $labels.model }}"

- alert: Inference_TTFT_P99_High
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(ttft_bucket[5m])) by (le, model)) * 1000 > 3000
  for: 2m
```
Tune the numbers for low-traffic models; use `by (region)` for region-scoped alerts.
